changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwrooms AS SELECT r.id, r.facility_id, r.department_type, r.department_id, r.name, r.type, r.floor, r.is_specific_gender, r.gender, r.created_date, r.is_active, r.created_by, r.last_modified_by, r.last_modified_date, r.appointable, r.parallel_capacity_value, r.default_duration_minutes, r.default_buffer_before_minutes, r.default_buffer_after_minutes FROM public.rooms r;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwrooms TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON report.rooms FROM report_user;
